about: Scene components being built in the lab, before they join a production. Each is ./<id>/scene.js. Kept by c.productions.

scenes.title: Currents before 2001
scenes.beat: A thread of short cycles runs from the 1930s past the 1970 staircase, and five differently behaved streams of the 1990s bend toward a meeting that has not happened yet.

scenes.title: Royce's cascade
scenes.beat: Work pours down a one-way run of steps, the last step breaks, and the flow keeps coming: the 1970 warning as a picture.

scenes.title: Snowbird: seventeen lights, one page
scenes.beat: Seventeen lights cross a night mountain from different directions, gather at a lodge and fuse into one page of four values.

scenes.title: The spread
scenes.beat: The page's light runs outward and hardens, station by station, from something people chose into something institutions require.

scenes.title: The badge factory
scenes.beat: One page is stamped into a city of identical badges, and ends as the smallest thing in view.

scenes.title: Three voices, and the turn
scenes.beat: Three lights leave the crowd in the badge city and speak; the third walks back to the page, and what warms is the people, not the towers.

scenes.title: The film, before it starts
scenes.beat: Six live screens hold the Agile film to come; each phrase of the hook turns to the screen it names, then the camera pulls back to show the whole story waiting.

scenes.title: The scroll and the curve
scenes.beat: A scroll is re-read from the top on every turn; laid on its side it becomes a chart: a line per message, a curve in total.

scenes.title: The 300,000 line
scenes.beat: A light goes straight through the gate at 300,000, and every real hand-over is marked beyond it.

scenes.title: The shelf
scenes.beat: The old light sets three pages on a shelf and its scroll rolls shut; a new light reads the shelf, not the scroll.

scenes.title: The keys and the test
scenes.beat: The old key is retired, a new one is cut, sealed envelopes are moved and one is opened; then two slips are compared and the gap is mended on the shelf.

scenes.title: The saving
scenes.beat: Two columns of context to true scale, the gap drawn as the thing saved, the floor that stays, and three lessons.

scenes.title: The refresh film's opening
scenes.beat: The film opens on the scroll and the racing counter, then folds into an agenda of seven live thumbnails of what is coming.

scenes.title: An agile cell
scenes.beat: The team that made the refresh film grows from one person through two maestros, a conductor and a lead to its helpers, is drawn round as an agile cell, then is archived and leaves its files on a shelf.

scenes.title: An agile cell grows
scenes.beat: Four lines of the Manifesto become four lights, then one cell; a person and agents join it and it puts out its roles, rules and work as files; it grows to 10, 20, 30 and 50 roles as an org chart, then folds onto a shelf as a stack of files.

scenes.title: Cells you can ask for
scenes.beat: One cell buds into five, each a different team for one kind of job: social media, website, CRM, design, agent behaviour policy.

scenes.title: Agile Cells: the proposition
scenes.beat: One small team works; crowded, it strains and bursts; it splits into six cells under the title Agile Cells, then two live cards open: how a cell works, and a cell working for real.

scenes.title: Agile, at any size
scenes.beat: A cell re-forms from its shelf of files; around it cells are built, work and fold onto their own stacks, tier on tier, until a calm library of cells sits under Agile Cells and sovereignwebsite.org.

scenes.title: Royce's cascade (portrait)
scenes.beat: A portrait copy of Royce's cascade for the vertical Agile film.

scenes.title: Currents before 2001 (portrait)
scenes.beat: A portrait copy of the currents for the vertical Agile film.

scenes.title: The values are sound
scenes.beat: Ron Jeffries's 2018 words that the Manifesto's values still offer the best way he knows; then four warm lights stay lit while a hard shell of plates accretes round them, layer on layer, the light still escaping through its gaps.
